newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -America Online buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -America Online buy repeated.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said on Monday it reiterated its buy rating for America Online Inc based on a likely report of an increase in subscriber growth and future market share.
-- The firm said in a report it expected America Online to update recent changes and direction in its half-yearly partners conference on Tuesday.

-- "We expect the big news out of the conference will be that subscriber growth in November is the highest in the company's history (probably over 300,000 new subscribers during the month)," analyst Brian Oakes wrote.
-- "This follows a strong October, in which AOL added 275,000" subscribers.

-- "This would confirm our belief that AOL's subscriber momentum has returned and should reach our estimate of 800,000 this quarter -- and possibly surpass one million new subscriber additions, based on December results."
-- American Online "most likely continues to gain market share -- an amazing feat given their current position at over 50 percent of the online marketplace."
-- America Online rose 1-1/2 to 36-7/8 in early trade.
